capabilities: Open the entire vault folder in Cursor
Open the active Markdown note in Cursor
Reuse an existing Cursor window when it already has the target directory open
Add Open in Cursor entries to file-explorer and editor context menus
Configure the Cursor CLI path, navigation and notification options
extras: Desktop app only (Windows/macOS/Linux); requires the cursor CLI on PATH. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand a note or vault folder to Cursor, so switching between notes and an AI coding session means locating files manually.

relations.evidence: Open your vault or current note in Cursor with one click.

summary: Integration that opens the vault or the current note in the Cursor editor, with context-menu, ribbon and command-palette entry points.
